mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_ID text, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME, DECODE(A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE ,#{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_XNZH},TO_CHAR(A.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),TO_CHAR(fin.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS VDATE, DECODE(A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE ,#{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_XNZH},TO_CHAR(A.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),TO_CHAR(fin.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS MDATE, A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE, A.PROFIT_TYPE FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A left join fin_product fin on fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B on A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
(A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_HBX} or (A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_JZX} and B.OPEN_TYPE in (#{PTL_ISSUE_MODE_FBS}, #{PTL_ISSUE_MODE_DQKF},#{PTL_ISSUE_MODE_GPKF})) ) and A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE in (#{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_CPZH}, #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_XNZH})
and (A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})

SELECT P.PORTFOLIO_NAME, P.PORTFOLIO_TYPE, P.PROFIT_TYPE, T.MOCK_ID, T.MOCK_DATE, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.VDATE, T.MDATE, T.BASE_RULE * 100 as baseRule , T.MGR_FEE_RATE * 100 as mgrFeeRate, T.RAISE_AMT_PLAN / 10000 as raiseAmtPlan, T.PRE_DAY_UNIT_VALUE, T.PRE_DAY_P_YIELD, T.PRE_DAY_CASH_POSITION, T.PRE_DAY_VAL_CHG * 100 as preDayValChg, T.PRE_DAY_SEVEN_DAY_RATE * 100 as preDaySevenDayRate, T.PRE_DAY_ASSET_VALUE, T.PRE_DAY_ASSET_NETVALUE, T.PRE_DAY_LEVER_RATE * 100 as preDayLeverRate , T.PRE_DAY_BPVALUE, T.PRE_DAY_AVGSURPLUSTIME, T.PRE_DAY_AVGSURPLUSTIME_P, T.PRE_DAY_PTL_M_DURATION, T.REAL_TIME_UNIT_VALUE, T.REAL_TIME_P_YIELD, T.REAL_TIME_CASH_POSITION, T.REAL_TIME_VAL_CHG * 100 as realTimeValChg, T.REAL_TIME_SEVEN_DAY_RATE * 100 as realTimeSevenDayRate , T.REAL_TIME_ASSET_VALUE, T.REAL_TIME_ASSET_NETVALUE, T.REAL_TIME_LEVER_RATE * 100 as realTimeLeverRate, T.REAL_TIME_BPVALUE, T.REAL_TIME_AVGSURPLUSTIME, T.REAL_TIME_AVGSURPLUSTIME_P, T.REAL_TIME_PTL_M_DURATION, T.AGAIN_INVEST_RATE * 100 as againInvestRate, T.FINAN_COST * 100 as finanCost, T.MOCK_UNIT_VALUE, T.MOCK_P_YIELD, T.MOCK_VAL_CHG * 100 as mockValChg, T.MOCK_CASH_POSITION, T.MOCK_ASSET_VALUE, T.MOCK_ASSET_NETVALUE, T.MOCK_LEVER_RATE * 100 as mockLeverRate, T.MOCK_BPVALUE, T.MOCK_AVGSURPLUSTIME, T.MOCK_AVGSURPLUSTIME_P, T.MOCK_PTL_M_DURATION, T.MOCK_SEVEN_DAY_RATE * 100 as mockSevenDayRate, T.MOCK_ONE_MONTH_RATE * 100 as mockOneMonthRate, T.MOCK_THREE_MONTH_RATE * 100 as mockThreeMonthRate, T.MOCK_QUARTER_DAY_RATE * 100 as mockQuarterDayRate, T.MOCK_ONE_YEAR_RATE * 100 as mockOneYearRate, T.MOCK_YIELD * 100 as mockYield, T.MOCK_RANGE_START_DATE, T.MOCK_RANGE_END_DATE, T.MOCK_RANGE_RATE * 100 as mockRangeRate, T.CREATE_USER, T.CREATE_DEPT, T.CREATE_TIME, T.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME FROM MOCK_TEST T inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO P ON T.PORTFOLIO_ID = P.PORTFOLIO_ID
T.MOCK_ID = #{mockId}
where MOCK_ID = #{mockId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by order_id asc
